details.report: Replaced the shallow pre-cast checks with validation against the shipped complete Recorder v2 JSON Schema, followed by centralized invocation/session and receipt-artifact semantic joins. loadPublicManifestSchema now exposes that real schema. Recorder publication now supplies the schema-required receipt artifact kind, while StatsLine continues to reuse validatePublicManifest as its sole manifest contract. Added a production-path regression proving execution.stdio.stderr="captured" is rejected before StatsLine consumes the manifest. Verified focused StatsLine/Recorder production and cold-install tests, typecheck, isolated-HOME full suite (358 passed, 5 skipped), package/cold-install path, npm pack dry-run with schema/source inclusion, and git diff check. No other PR39 class was repaired.

classesRepaired.name: single-recorder-manifest-contract
